measured_values_reason: Null by seed/contract.yaml's own convention: every quantity recorded null is measured at Phase 1 build time on the grading host and never authored at Phase 0. The 2026-08-18 repoint from PatchCamelyon to STL-10 additionally nulled the anchors this slot's previous design carried -- the per-configuration bars b_c, the slow and fast time anchors and the reference completion time -- because they were measured on a substrate this slot no longer uses. Authoring a floor, a knee or an ablation worth here would invent a measurement the bytes have not earned.
ramp_units: seconds. The axis is the mean bar-gated wall clock over the attempt's graded configurations and it is descending: floor is the slow anchor, the per-configuration ceiling, and knee is the fast anchor at which reward saturates. dichotomizing_threshold is a time on the same axis, not a score. The ramp between them is logarithmic, matching the reward map: S_outcome = clamp((ln floor - ln T) / (ln floor - ln knee), 0, 1).
